costs.subtitle: Full cost of buying a $680K property with a 75% mortgage. All mandatory payments and fees.

items.d: Dubai Land Department — mandatory transaction fee. Based on property value.
Mortgage registration with DLD. Based on loan amount, not property value.
Bank fee for arranging the mortgage. Based on loan amount. Can be added to the loan.
Independent property valuation. Done by a bank-appointed valuer. Fixed fee.
Mandatory life insurance for the borrower for the loan amount. Depends on age and health.
Insurance against fire, flood, theft. Minimum — structural coverage.
Standard agent commission on the secondary market. On off-plan — 0% (paid by developer).

items.q: Can I get a mortgage remotely?
items.a: Yes. Pre-qualification and document collection are done remotely. For the final Loan Agreement signing and DLD closing, one trip to the UAE for 3–5 days is required. Signing can be delegated via PoA.

Yes, it's Mashreq's basic Initial Rate for year one. After that the rate switches to a Variable Rate (3M EIBOR + 2.5–3.5% spread) — typically 5.5–6.5%. You can also choose a Fixed Rate for 3–5 years (5.99–6.49%).

items.q: Will banks lend to a Russian / Belarusian citizen?
items.a: Yes. Mashreq, Emirates NBD, ADCB, RAK Bank openly work with Russian and Belarusian passports. HSBC requires history with a non-Russian bank. FAB — case-by-case. Sanctions screening is mandatory.

items.q: What is DBR and why does it matter?
items.a: Debt Burden Ratio — UAE Central Bank limit: all monthly debt payments ≤ 50% of monthly income. With $7K income — max $3,500 / mo on mortgage. This sets the loan size ceiling.

items.q: Can I get a mortgage on off-plan?
items.a: Yes, but not on all projects. Banks only finance approved developers (EMAAR, DAMAC, Sobha, Nakheel, Meraas, Azizi). Disbursement is by milestones. Ready property is simpler and gets a lower rate.

30 days late — 1% penalty on the payment. 60 days — the bank demands clearance. 90+ days — foreclosure: bank sells the property at auction. Proceeds cover the debt; the rest is refunded to you. Better — renegotiate the schedule in advance.

Yes, anytime. Early repayment penalty — 1% of outstanding balance (capped at 10,000 AED). After the 5-year fixed period — no penalty. Often it's cheaper to pay off in 10 years instead of 25 — saves 40–60% of interest.

items.q: What matters more — rate or amount?
items.a: Depends on strategy. For 3–5 year flip — low down payment and flexible rate. For long-term hold — low fixed rate. For rental income — cashflow > payment (positive cash flow).
